To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new abietene derivative, 1, has been identified and isolated from the rhizome of Kaempfera angustifolia, and its cytotoxicity against four cancer cell lines was evaluated.
a new abietene-type diterpene was identified from the rhizome extract and the cytotoxicity of this diterpene and the known compound zeylenol was evaluated.
kaempfolienal, a new abietene-type diterpenoid, was isolated from Kaempfera angustifolia and its cytotoxic activity was evaluated against four human cancer cell lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of a new abietene-type diterpene and other compounds from K. angustifolia and the biological evaluation of zeylenol (3) and its derivatives against the four cancer cell lines.
the isolation and structural elucidation of a new diterpene from K. angustifolia, and the evaluation of its biological activities.
the isolation of a new abietene derivative and other compounds from the rhizome extract and the biological evaluation of the isolated compounds against four cancer cell lines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cytotoxic activity is mainly dependent on the presence of the hydroxyl groups at C-7 and C-9.
zeylenol (1) was found to be a potent cytotoxic compound with IC50 values ranging from 1.5 to 4.3 μM.
zeylenol is the most potent cytotoxic compound among all tested.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cytotoxic activity of 1 and the zeylene derivatives was comparable to that of zeylenol (1) against the four cell lines.
kaempfolienols, the new abietene derivatives, were synthesized and evaluated for their cytotoxic activities.
the cytotoxic activities of zeylenol and kaempfolienal are similar to that of zeylenal and that the cytotoxicity of zeyleninol is comparable to that of zeleninol.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the abietene dimer 1, the zeylenols 2 and 3, and the epoxide derivative 6 exhibited moderate cytotoxic activity against the MCF-7 cell line.
the cytotoxic activity of the zeylenoid derivatives is not related to their structural features.
the cytotoxicity of zeylenol and its derivatives was not significantly affected by the presence or absence of the epoxide group.
